narrative.synopsis: Ares, usually the force of battle, becomes helpless when the Aloid giants trap him in a bronze jar. The war god survives only because Hermes learns where he is hidden and frees him.
narrative.openingSituation: Otus and Ephialtes are strong enough to challenge even Olympian powers.
narrative.centralConflict: Ares is removed from battle and sealed in a humiliating prison.
narrative.resolution: Hermes finds the jar and releases him.
narrative.outcome: The story exposes the vulnerability of brute war when cunning and rescue are absent.
